scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Bridegroom must be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry
Bride must be at least 18 years old
Application must be submitted at least 15 days before the date of marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,500 to the bridegroom.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
